summary.intent: Review and finish the second implementer's work (skipping workflow generation for a private workspace root) in its worktree, getting the full verify suite passing, after pushing and linking the first implementer's work to trail 250.
summary.outcome: Fixed a failing init test and updated npm platform package tests, added a changeset, and got all five verify checks passing on the private-root branch. Started checking how the existing Cargo note avoids repeated output, since `init` printed the skip note three times.

repo: Verification is run through a shared verify.sh script that takes a worktree path and writes logs (verify.pre-push.log, verify.test.log) to the temp dir; output is filtered with grep for PASS|FAIL.
Tests run with cargo nextest (`--no-fail-fast -p callisto-graph -p callisto-cli`); individual lib tests can be run with `cargo test -p callisto-cli --lib <name>`.
Changes to the workspace/private-root behavior require a changeset file in .changeset/ (e.g. skip-private-workspace-root.md).

The init command's tests live in crates/callisto-cli/src/commands/init/tests.rs, including unsupported_workspace_skips_workflow_generation_with_a_json_diagnostic and platform_workspace_without_napi_targets.

npm platform package behavior is covered by crates/callisto-graph/tests/npm_platform_packages_test.rs (e.g. workspace_member_platform_packages_attach_too, platform_packages_are_manifests_of_their_owner_not_packages), which needed updating for the private-root change.
Existing user-facing notes use `eprintln!("note:...` in callisto-graph/src, with a Cargo 'no version' note as a precedent for deduplication.

code.finding: The unsupported_workspace_skips_workflow_generation_with_a_json_diagnostic test failed after the private-root change and was edited to match the new behavior, modeled on platform_workspace_without_napi_targets.
Two platform-package tests were bulk-updated via a helper Python script (run with python3 -I) to account for private workspace roots.

workflow: Worktree-based parallel implementers: each implementer's work is reviewed in its own worktree by running the shared verify script, then fixing remaining failures.
After a fix, re-run the full verify rather than only the targeted test, since the full test step still failed after the first fix.
Use a throwaway script outside the repo for repetitive test edits, and run cargo fmt before verifying.
Check first-run UX of new diagnostics, not just test pass/fail; here `init` printed the skip note three times.

friction: The full test step still failed after the first fix, because other tests in callisto-graph depended on the old private-root behavior, requiring a second round of investigation.
The `init` command printed the new skip note three times, noisy for a new user's first command.
open_items: Deduplicate the private-workspace-root skip note so `init` prints it only once, following the existing Cargo note pattern.
Finish reviewing the third implementer's work, since all three implementers were reported back but only the first two are covered here.
